 SEGI FRESH STEPS FORWARD TO SUPPORT SELANGOR FLOOD RECOVERY THROUGH RM200,000 JOINT VOUCHER INITIATIVE
 By VOICE OF ASEAN - November 20, 2026 0 48 
 Facebook Twitter Pinterest WhatsApp 
 Retailer leverages its neighbourhood network to help flood-affected families replenish daily essentials, setting an example for meaningful retail-sector community action. 
 KUALA SELANGOR, Malaysia , Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — Segi Fresh, a Malaysian neighbourhood Fresh Mart retailer under Segi Value Holdings, is taking a proactive role in supporting Selangor’s flood recovery through a RM200,000 joint shopping voucher initiative with Yayasan Sultan Selangor (YSS).
 The initiative comprises RM100,000 from Segi Value Holdings and RM100,000 from YSS, providing RM500 in Segi Fresh shopping vouchers to up to 400 flood-affected families.
 The initiative was highlighted during a relief programme held yesterday at the temporary evacuation centre (PPS) at Sekolah Kebangsaan Parit Mahang, Kuala Selangor, in conjunction with a visit by His Highness Tengku Amir Shah ibni Sultan Sharafuddin Idris Shah Alhaj, the Raja Muda of Selangor . The programme was coordinated with YSS, the Selangor State Disaster Management Unit (UPBN) and relevant authorit ies. 
 Segi Fresh Assists Flood Victims via Shopping Voucher RM200,000 
 Mobilising Retail Resources for Community Recovery 
 Recognising that recovery continues long after floodwaters recede, Segi Fresh is focusing its assistance on helping families replenish fresh food, groceries and essential household supplies.
 Rather than providing unrestricted cash assistance, the shopping vouchers are designed to address everyday household needs, complemented by Segi Fresh’s established retail presence across Selangor and access through participating neighbourhood stores.
 Dato’ Chui Ah Hock, Group Chief Executive Officer of Segi Value Holdings, said the initiative reflects the role retailers can play beyond their daily business operations.
 “ As a retailer serving communities across Selangor, we believe it is our responsibility to step forward when families face difficult times. Through our partnership with YSS, we are putting our retail network and resources to practical use, helping affected families replenish their everyday essentials. 
 “We hope this initiative demonstrates how the retail sector can contribute meaningfully to community recovery and encourages broader collective efforts,” he said.
 The initiative reflects Segi Fresh’s ambition to become Malaysia’s Top 1 Fresh Mart, demonstrating that its commitment extends beyond retail growth to making a positive difference in the communities it serves.
